label: Peplink PSW-8-240W-RUG
description: Rugged industrial 8-port PoE+ SD switch with two 1G SFP cages and a 90 W PoE budget as shipped (240 W with the optional 180 W PSU).
notes:
Vendor figures from the Peplink SD Switch Rugged datasheet (ref sd-switch-rugged-202109-v14, re-exported 2023-11-17): **8x 802.3at (PoE+) GE Ports, 2x SFP Ports** (1G cages, not SFP+), DC Power DIN 2x 54V plus Terminal Block 12V-56V DC, 20 W system power, fanless, -40 to 65 C.

The PoE budget is the one number the model name gets wrong, and it is the number this catalogue used to take from the name. The 8-port column reads "20W System, 90W PoE+ Power Budget (supports up to 240W)", with the footnote "The bundled PSU provides 90W of PoE power budget. If you require 240W of power budget, please add 180W PSU (ACW-630) to your device." The same sheet's Package Content row puts a **120 W** PSU in the box. So a box out of the crate funds 90 W of PoE, not 240 W: 8 x 30 W is the platform's ceiling with the optional supply fitted, and a lab that assumes 240 W will over-commit the switch by 150 W. The 2019 switch datasheet (ref sdswitch-201811-v5) states the identical pair and names the accessory ACW-623 instead of ACW-630; both are 180 W at 54 V.

Recorded as a ceiling the model does not reach rather than silently renamed: the SKU still says 240W, and a reader comparing the two deserves to see why the number differs. research/peplink-psw-poe-budget.md has the quotes, the retailer pages that disagree with each other, and what a bench reading would settle.

poe.note: 90 W, which is what the box's own supply funds - NOT the 240 W in the model name. Peplink's rugged datasheet (ref sd-switch-rugged-202109-v14) gives the 8-port column as "20W System, 90W PoE+ Power Budget (supports up to 240W#)" and footnotes it "# The bundled PSU provides 90W of PoE power budget. If you require 240W of power budget, please add 180W PSU (ACW-630) to your device." The 2019 switch datasheet (ref sdswitch-201811-v5) says the same with the accessory named ACW-623: "8 ports, 90W power budget (Upgradable to 240W)" and "* The bundled PSU provides 90W of PoE+ power budget. Additional ACW-623 (180W PSU) is required to enable up to 240W power budget." The Package Content row agrees with the footnote rather than with the name: the 8-port ships with 1x 120W PSU, and 120 W - 20 W system = 100 W of supply, out of which the declared 90 W budget is drawn (the 24-port rugged does the same arithmetic on its 180 W PSU: 180 - 50 = 130 W supply, 120 W budget). 240 W is 8 x 30 W, the full 802.3at class ceiling, and it is only reachable with the extra supply. research/peplink-psw-poe-budget.md.
